Step 1 — Determine if document is an invoice
- Contains clear invoice indicators: header "TAX INVOICE", "Document No.", "Date", "Net Total", "Gross Total", charge line items, GST references. No exclusion indicators like "Mahnung" or "Zahlungserinnerung". Verdict: it's an invoice.

Step 2 — Locate Invoice Date
- Multiple occurrences of "Date" with value "01-12-2022" in header lines (pages 1–3). Evidence consistent. Extract Invoice.Date = "01-12-2022".

Step 3 — Identify Sender VAT/Tax ID
- Header shows "PAN No.: AACCA7791D" and also "Our GST Reg No." / "PAN" area. Page 2 prints "PAN No.: 33AACCA7791D1ZT" but careful: page 1 shows "PAN No.: AACCA7791D" and elsewhere "Our GST Reg No. 33AACCA7791D1ZT".
- Determine Sender.VatId: the GST registration format "33AACCA7791D1ZT" is explicitly labeled "Our GST Reg No." so extract Sender.VatId = "33AACCA7791D1ZT".
- Note: PAN AACCA7791D also present but GST is required for VatId.

Step 4 — Locate Grand Total Amount
- Page 3 shows "Gross Total" and final numeric text: "121,921.38" and "AMOUNT IN WORDS INR ONE-HUNDRED-AND-TWENTY-ONE-THOUSAND-NINE-HUNDRED-AND-TWENTY-ONE AND PAISE THIRTY-EIGHT- ONLY".
- GrandTotal.Amount = 121921.38 (preserve decimals).

Step 5 — Locate Net Amount
- Page 2/3 shows "Net Total 103,323.20" and table "Net INR 103,323.20".
- Net.Amount = 103323.20.

Step 6 — Identify VAT groups, rates and amounts
- Tax table (page 3) shows SGST/UTGST % = 9.0 Tax INR = 9,299.09 and CGST % = 9.0 Tax INR = 9,299.09. Both correspond to the Net group "B".
- Possible interpretations:
  - Provide each tax line as separate VAT entries (SGST 9% -> 9,299.09; CGST 9% -> 9,299.09). This matches shown percentages and amounts exactly.
  - Alternatively, combine into a single 18% VAT group with total VAT 18,598.18 — but that would be an inference/aggregation not explicitly shown as a single VAT rate. Rule: do not infer missing values. So prefer extracting the explicit lines.
- Therefore extract two VAT entries with Vat.Rate = 9 (for each), Vat.Amounts = 9299.09, Net.Amount for those groups corresponds to the Net group total 103,323.20 (table shows Net INR 103,323.20 for group B). According to schema, Net.Amount and Vat.Amount should match the group; retain decimals.

Step 7 — Preserve formatting and decimals; do not guess currencies
- All monetary values are in INR per document; schema requires numbers without currency symbols.
- Keep decimals as in source (two decimals).

Step 8 — Summarize chosen extractions for mapping to schema fields
- Invoice.Date: "01-12-2022"
- Sender.VatId: "33AACCA7791D1ZT"
- GrandTotal.Amount: 121921.38
- Net.Amount: 103323.20
- Vat entries: two explicit lines:
  - Vat.Rate 9 -> Vat.Amount 9299.09
  - Vat.Rate 9 -> Vat.Amount 9299.09

Step 9 — Confirm compliance with rules
- No inference beyond explicit document values.
- Multiple VAT occurrences retained as separate entries (per instructions to allow multiple).
- Decimals preserved.

Proceed to produce final JSON with these extracted values.
